svg.title: Azure CycleCloud Multi-region plugin for AMLFS architecture
svg.desc: Azure CycleCloud provisions regional compute VMs. Slurm schedules jobs, and the cyclecloud-multi-region plugin coordinates Azure Managed Lustre transfers using the scheduler's managed identity for ARM requests. One example job runs in Region B. In order: archive input from home Region A to Blob; import input into Region B; run the job using local Lustre I/O; archive output from Region B to Blob; import output back into Region A; complete. Violet highlights the active transfer path. Each illustrative stage lasts four seconds. AMLFS HSM moves file bytes through Blob Storage. Reduced-motion mode shows the static architecture and staging sequence.

g.text: Example job: Region A (home) to Region B (remote)
Stage-in: A to Blob to B | Run in B | Stage-out: B to Blob to A
Stage-in: archive input from home AMLFS (Region A) to shared Blob.
Stage-in: import input from shared Blob into Region B AMLFS.
Compute in Region B reads input and writes output on its local /lustre.
Stage-out: archive output from Region B AMLFS to shared Blob.
Stage-out: import output from shared Blob back to home AMLFS (Region A).
Complete: output is available on Region A /lustre.
Illustrative timing. AMLFS HSM transfers data through Blob Storage.
